stories.label: Pakistan-Afghanistan forces trade fire at border amid multi-front crisis
stories.summary: Pakistan and Taliban-run Afghanistan exchanged fire at their border. Follows Pakistan's Feb 22 strikes on 7 militant camps inside Afghanistan. Taliban's first significant military response. Pakistan facing simultaneous KSE crash, KP terror attacks, and border confrontation.

stories.label: Israeli forces fired 900+ bullets killing 15 Gaza medics execution-style
stories.summary: Independent forensic investigation found Israeli soldiers fired 900+ bullets at aid workers, killing 15 execution-style. Satellite imagery shows bulldozers buried vehicles and earth berms constructed to hide evidence. Comes as Israel bans 37 aid organizations from Gaza and West Bank.

stories.label: Pentagon threatens Anthropic with Cold War-era powers over military AI
stories.summary: Pentagon gave Anthropic Friday deadline to agree to unrestricted military AI use or face Cold War-era compulsion powers (likely Defense Production Act). Anthropic has dug in, refusing to remove safety restrictions. Escalated from 'cutting ties' threat to government coercion.

stories.label: Japan to deploy missiles on island 110km from Taiwan by 2031
stories.summary: Japan deploying missiles to Yonaguni island, 110km from Taiwan, by 2031. Most explicit Taiwan contingency preparation by a US ally. Part of Japan's post-2022 remilitarization doubling defense budget to 2% GDP.

stories.label: Brazil floods kill 28+ in Minas Gerais — mining region's structural vulnerability
stories.summary: 28+ killed, 40+ missing in landslides across Minas Gerais after torrential rains. Same region as Brumadinho and Mariana mining disasters. La Niña-driven, compounded by mining-stripped hillsides.

stories.label: Amazon accused of systematic scheme to inflate prices across economy
stories.summary: Investigation reveals Amazon operating systematic scheme to inflate prices not just on its platform but across the entire economy. Fee structure and marketplace rules create upward price pressure affecting all retail.

stories.label: Mercury 2 diffusion-based LLM challenges autoregressive AI paradigm
stories.summary: Inception Labs released Mercury 2, a reasoning LLM built on diffusion (not autoregressive) architecture. If benchmarks hold, challenges fundamental assumptions of the AI industry. Awaiting independent verification.

stories.label: Iran crisis — Geneva talks Thursday, China missile deal confirmed
stories.summary: Geneva talks set for Thursday Feb 26. Iran FM says deal 'within reach.' Second US carrier heading to Middle East. Not covered this cycle — editorial threshold requires outcome, military action, deal framework, or direct escalation.

stories.label: Ukraine-Russia war — 4th anniversary, execution testimony
stories.summary: War entering 5th year. Petal mines endangering civilians. No diplomatic breakthrough. Importance decayed — covered extensively, need major development to justify re-selection.

stories.label: US tells Afghan allies to give up — 173-year resettlement backlog
stories.summary: DHS admits 173-year processing backlog. 180,000 Afghans in pipeline. Camp As-Sayliyah closing March 31. Watch for court challenges, congressional response.

stories.label: Lebanon army ordered to respond after Israeli fire on military post
stories.summary: Lebanese Army authorized to return fire after Israeli forces fired on military post. Shifts dynamic from Israel vs. Hezbollah to Israel vs. sovereign military.

stories.label: Thai and Cambodian armies exchange fire at disputed border
stories.summary: Thai and Cambodian militaries exchanged live fire at their border. Situation appears quiet this cycle but unresolved.

stories.label: Stripe reportedly in talks to acquire PayPal
stories.summary: Bloomberg report only, not confirmed. Would be one of largest fintech deals ever.

stories.label: China-Japan export war / US chip control regime under pressure
stories.summary: China sanctioned 40 Japanese entities and DeepSeek circumvented Nvidia Blackwell ban. Export control regime simultaneously retaliated against and evaded.

stories.label: M23 spokesperson killed in drone strike — Congo mineral war
stories.summary: M23 spokesperson killed by drone in eastern DRC. DRC-Burundi border reopened for trade and aid to South Kivu. Watch for Rwanda response.

stories.label: Israel orders 37 aid organizations to halt operations in Gaza and West Bank
stories.summary: Israel ordered 37 aid groups to halt all operations in Gaza, West Bank, and East Jerusalem. Aid groups petitioning Israeli Supreme Court. Connected to medics massacre — systematic dismantling of humanitarian access. Not selected as standalone but integral to Gaza medics story.

stories.label: ICC prosecution: Duterte drew up 'death lists' for drug war
stories.summary: ICC prosecutors revealed Duterte personally drew up 'death lists.' First SE Asian head of state at ICC. Hearing ongoing.

stories.label: US tariff upheaval — Section 122 tariffs in effect
stories.summary: Trump warned countries against backing away from trade deals in State of the Union. No major new development. Importance continues to decay.

stories.label: Mexico CJNG crisis — aftermath of El Mencho death
stories.summary: Mexico says Jalisco situation stabilized, flights resuming. 70+ killed in aftermath. BBC reports threat of further violence looms. Cartel fragmentation risk remains.

stories.label: Sudan war — MSF closes hospital on Chad border
stories.summary: MSF closed El Tina hospital on Chad border after renewed fighting displaced 400 families. Quad ceasefire proposal still on table. Fresh humanitarian data available — prioritize next cycle.

stories.label: Sahel jihadist groups probing coastal West Africa
stories.summary: Jihadist groups expanding from Sahel into coastal West Africa. Watch for Côte d'Ivoire, Ghana, Togo incidents.

stories.label: Chinese scientists build world's smallest transistor for AI chips
stories.summary: World's smallest ferroelectric transistor integrating memory and processing. Alternative architecture path that may circumvent export controls.

stories.label: Russia opens criminal case against Telegram founder Durov
stories.summary: Both France and Russia pursuing criminal cases against Durov. Democratic and authoritarian states targeting same encrypted platform.

stories.label: Netanyahu announces Israel-India 'hexagon' alliance
stories.summary: Netanyahu framed 6-nation alliance against 'radical axes.' Modi addressing Knesset with Israeli opposition boycotting.

stories.label: Settlers kill Palestinian teen while Israeli soldiers watched
stories.summary: Settlers attacked Mukhmas, killed teenager while soldiers stood by. Military complicity pattern.

stories.label: Moscow bomb kills police officer on Ukraine war anniversary
stories.summary: Bomb in Moscow killed police officer on 4th anniversary of Ukraine invasion. Internal security strain.

stories.label: Deadly floods sweep Peru — 700+ districts in emergency
stories.summary: 700+ districts declared emergency. La Niña-driven. Brazil floods in same weather pattern are now the more acute disaster.

stories.label: Israel designates Palestinian news outlets as terrorist groups
stories.summary: 5 Palestinian news orgs designated terrorist groups. Physical shutdowns enforced in Jerusalem.

stories.label: US withdraws from NE Syria, abandoning Kurdish allies
stories.summary: US pulling out of NE Syria. Full withdrawal within a month.

stories.label: Panama takes control of canal ports from Hong Kong firm
stories.summary: Supreme Court declared CK Hutchison concession unconstitutional.

stories.label: IBM posts worst day in 25 years after AI threatens COBOL moat
stories.summary: IBM steepest stock drop since 2000 after AI showed it can modernize COBOL.

stories.label: Hidden human labor behind 'autonomous' humanoid robots exposed
stories.summary: MIT Tech Review reveals humanoid robot companies hiding human operators.

stories.label: Nigeria central bank cuts rate to 26.5%
stories.summary: Nigeria cut benchmark rate to 26.5%. Inflation above 30%, 133M in poverty.
